text: The Taj Mahal was commissioned by the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
The Taj Mahal is located in Agra, Uttar Pradesh, India.
Construction of the Taj Mahal began around 1632 and the main mausoleum was completed around 1638.
Akbar was a Mughal emperor who ruled the Mughal Empire from 1556 to 1605.
The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris, France.
The Eiffel Tower was completed in 1889 for the Exposition Universelle.
